scope: OpenAPI pagination bounds for the 25 solution-lifecycle Gateway list routes
finding: All 25 list endpoints relied on service-level page validation, while their route signatures used string query parameters without published min/max bounds.
change: Route query parameters now use typed FastAPI Query declarations aligned to each downstream reader/action validator. Existing defaults and service-side validation remain unchanged; invalid query values return 422 before service invocation.

openapi_and_invalid_query_regression.coverage: All 25 routes publish the expected default/minimum/maximum and reject limit=0, limit=101, and offset=-1 before the mocked service can run.

rollback: Revert the Query parameter declarations and the focused OpenAPI regression; no migration or persisted data changed.
limitations: This verifies FastAPI OpenAPI generation and in-process request validation only; it does not establish live proxy behavior or database/service availability.
